_meta.disclaimer: PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION RATES ONLY — not official Schedule of Rates figures. Do not use for procurement or audit purposes.
_meta.basis: Indicative figures compiled for hackathon demonstration from publicly available construction cost indices and news articles. They do NOT represent any government Schedule of Rates (SoR) and MUST NOT be used for actual procurement, tendering, or audit decisions.
_meta.replace_instructions: To swap in real data: replace the 'categories' block with entries that share the same JSON schema (unit, rate_inr.low/high, typical_quantity.low/high, confidence, assumptions). The API will pick up the new catalogue on next restart without any code change.
_meta.units_note: All monetary values are in Indian Rupees (INR). Rate ranges are approximate and cover plain-terrain, generic-specification works.

road.label: Road / Link Road / Pathway Construction

rate_inr.note: Lower end: gravel/WBM single-lane rural track; upper end: BT double-lane with side drains and shoulders

typical_quantity.note: MPLAD road works typically range from short link roads (~0.5 km) to longer rural arterials (~6 km)

assumptions: Single or double-lane rural road with WBM/BT/CC surface
Excludes land acquisition, utility relocation, and retaining walls
Hilly or waterlogged terrain may increase cost by 50–150%
Rate includes formation, sub-base, base, and wearing course

community_hall.label: Community Centre / Community Hall / Panchayat Building

rate_inr.note: Lower end: load-bearing brick construction; upper end: RCC framed with full finishes

typical_quantity.note: Small village hall to multi-room community centre

assumptions: RCC framed structure or load-bearing brick with basic finishes
Includes flooring, doors/windows, electrification, and plumbing
Excludes site development, boundary wall, and furniture
Typical MPLAD building project: 1,000 – 5,000 sq ft

street_lighting.label: Street Lighting / Solar Lighting Installation

rate_inr.note: Lower end: standalone solar LED; upper end: grid-connected high-mast fitting with civil works

typical_quantity.note: A village/ward scheme typically covers 15–250 points

assumptions: Includes pole, LED fitting, wiring/cable trenching, and metering
Solar standalone units at lower end; grid-connected at upper end
Excludes transformer upgrade or HT line extension
Battery and controller included for solar variants

drainage.label: Drainage / Nali / Gutter / Storm-Water Channel

rate_inr.note: Lower end: brick open drain; upper end: RCC box culvert or covered channel

typical_quantity.note: A typical ward-level drain scheme: 150 m to 2,500 m

assumptions: Brick-masonry or RCC open/covered drain
Excludes earthwork disposal beyond 50 m lead
Includes manhole/inspection chamber at every 30 m for covered drains
Higher end applies to RCC box culvert with road reinstatement

borewell.label: Borewell / Tube-well / Hand Pump / Water Supply Scheme

rate_inr.note: Lower end: basic hand pump; upper end: motorised borewell + overhead tank + piped distribution

typical_quantity.note: Single installation to a village cluster scheme with multiple points

assumptions: Includes drilling (up to 200 ft depth), casing pipe, pump, and outlet
Motorised borewell includes submersible pump, control panel, and pressure vessel
Overhead tank scheme includes tank, pump house, and distribution mains
Actual cost varies significantly with local geological conditions and depth required

other.label: Other / Unclassified Work
assumptions: Work category could not be matched to a known MPLAD work type
Very wide range reflects uncertainty — manual review of description is essential
Confidence is LOW; do not use this estimate for any scoring without human review

state_cost_index._schema_note: Multiplicative factor applied to base rates. 1.00 = national average baseline. Source: prototype approximation — replace with state-specific PWD SoR factors.
